licenses._comment: Single source of truth for the license allowlist + aliases + exceptions. Migrated from the legacy config.toml: fuzzy/wildcard strings normalized to canonical SPDX; UNLICENSED removed (it was a license-checker private->UNLICENSED artifact, not a policy decision); Public Domain dropped (no SPDX id - use CC0-1.0). Entries are validated by src/validate-policy.js against the official SPDX list.
licenses._expr_note: Expressions are stored paren-free and operand-sorted to match the normalizer's canonical form (src/normalize.js). Operand reordering across mixed AND/OR is a known limitation.
licenses._aliases_note: Curated, reviewed map of free-text license.name strings -> canonical SPDX id. This is reject-by-default: ONLY strings listed here are resolved; anything else stays undetermined and fails closed. To add an entry: verify the package's real licence, then map its declared string to a valid SPDX id. Never map a proprietary marker (UNLICENSED, etc.). Bare 'BSD' maps to BSD-2-Clause; both BSD-2/3-Clause are allowlisted so the gate outcome is unaffected by the clause ambiguity.
